reply.text: This is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I can't tell you what's causing it or whether it's something to worry about. Please get it looked at, and if it's severe, spreading, or comes with weakness, don't wait on it. Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they say and I'll train around it. In the meantime, I'd rather we keep the squats honest and not guess. Want to talk through how you're loading and setting up the squat in the meantime, or take a look at the rest of your week?
